premises.text: Online fraud is a significant and growing problem for e-commerce merchants
premises.evidence_span: Fraud is an enormous problem for e-commerce merchants. Last year, $20 billion was lost to online fraud. And the real bad thing is, at present, it's growing at twice the rate of online commerce.

premises.text: Current fraud prevention methods are ineffective and hinder conversions
premises.evidence_span: What you have at the moment is you have a number of solutions which really aren't working. It's more commerce prevention.

premises.text: Trustive provides real-time online identity verification using social fingerprinting
premises.evidence_span: We're a real-time online identity verification platform. We focus on using social fingerprinting.

premises.text: Trustive collects and analyzes social and behavioral data to verify customer identity
premises.evidence_span: Our platform uses social data as a primary. We add in behavioral data, transactional data.

premises.text: Trustive can pre-populate online checkout forms to enhance user experience
premises.evidence_span: we pre-populate the online checkout form with the customer's data, so their name, their address, and their email.

premises.text: Trustive provides a score indicating the authenticity of the customer
premises.evidence_span: we can report back to the merchant a score of 0 to 100, which indicates whether or not the customer is actually who they say they are.

premises.text: Trustive operates on a per-transaction pricing model
premises.evidence_span: It's a very simple enterprise model. As you can see, it's per transaction. You just pay for what you use.

value.text: E-commerce merchants can conduct transactions with verified customers, reducing fraud
value.evidence_span: We're trusted and we're here to eliminate fraud.
